# Security Vulnerability Report

> **⚠️ Do NOT use this template for security vulnerabilities.**
>
> Security issues must be reported **privately** to avoid exposing live
> systems to attack. Public issue reports will be deleted on sight.
>
> ## How to report a security vulnerability
>
> **Open a private security advisory:**
>
> https://github.com/ahmedkobbi/smart-edms/security/advisories/new
>
> The Author commits to:
>
> - Acknowledging receipt within **72 hours**.
> - Providing an initial assessment within **7 days**.
> - Coordinating disclosure timing with you once a fix is available.
>
> ## What to include in your report
>
> Please provide as much of the following as possible:
>
> - A clear description of the vulnerability and the affected component(s).
> - A proof-of-concept or step-by-step reproduction.
> - The impact — what an attacker could achieve (data leak, privilege
>   escalation, RCE, etc.) and the prerequisites (auth required? tenant
>   context? specific configuration?).
> - Any suggested remediation.
> - Whether you intend to publish the details publicly, and on what
>   timeline (so we can coordinate disclosure).
>
> ## Do NOT include
>
> - Real production credentials, tokens, or KEK values.
> - Real document content or PII from a production database.
> - Active exploit code that could be run as-is against a live deployment.
>
